target_onset_transform: sort latent LHS onsets, scale to 1.6-(N-1)*0.05 seconds, then add 0.05 seconds per temporal rank
matching: unrestricted Hungarian: squared octaves + squared seconds
metric: whole-phrase cosine after unrestricted Hungarian matching
sd: Across candidate phrases, ddof=1; descriptive, not a confidence interval

renderer.candidate_coordinates: independent elementwise bounded logits; no ordering, spacing, canonicalization, or Magic Clamp
